crossRefs.note: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you…

translations.web: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
translations.bsb: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
translations.kjv: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
translations.asv: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
